locator.text: Equation (6.29), p. 70, in the statement of Proposition 6.6

evidence: paper: \forall I \in \mathbb{N}_0^5 \ \exists C_{j,I}, b_{j,I}, d_{j,I} : \quad |\partial^I a_{\gamma,m}| \le C_{j,I}\, \varepsilon^{\alpha}\, S_*^{b_{j,I}}\, \sqrt{\zeta}\, \delta^{-d_{j,I}}\, P_v, \qquad 0 \le v \le L_s

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same bound after three routine rewritings, all of them in the repository. (i) Separate degrees versus one: Lean's majorant is C ε^α (S_* · max 1 δ⁻¹)^p √ζ P in place of the paper's C ε^α S_*^{b} δ^{-d} √ζ P. Forward: (6.29) implies the Lean bound with p = b + d, which is exactly `separate_powers_le_growth`. Backward: growth^p = S_*^p (max 1 δ⁻¹)^p is of the paper's shape with b = d = p. The two forms could diverge only where δ > 1, since there max 1 δ⁻¹ = 1 > δ^{-d}; that regime does not occur in the instantiated strips, because `WeightedRadialPrimitive.delta` is min 1 (min x (L - x)) and `delta_le_one` gives δ ≤ 1, so max 1 δ⁻¹ = δ⁻¹ identically along the chain logStripData → localStripData → movingStripData → nativeStrip. The repository says as much in the `growth` docstring ("agreeing with delta⁻¹ when delta ≤ 1") and supplies `MemClass.of_separate_bounds` for the forward direction. (ii) Multi-indices versus operator norms: ∂^I over I ∈ ℕ_0^5 becomes ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x‖ for j ≤ m, equivalent up to a factor depending only on the dimension and the order, absorbed into C. (iii) Quantifier order: the paper allows C_{j,I}, b_{j,I}, d_{j,I} to depend on the multi-index, Lean takes one C and one p per order bound m — which is the stronger reading for each fixed m and, m being arbitrary, gives back the paper's per-index form. The factors ε^α, √ζ and P_v match `WaveClass` term for term. (iv) The side condition 0 ≤ v ≤ L_s: the Lean has no v-restriction at all. `MemClass.bounds` quantifies over every `x ∈ s.domain`, and for the strip in use the domain imposes nothing on the v-coordinate — `nativeStrip_mem` restricts only the slow factor (x.2.1 ∈ U.carrier and profileRadius ∈ Ioo (leftRadius W) (rightRadius W)). That cuts in the direction of strength: the bound is asserted at more points than the paper's, not fewer. It is not vacuous outside the paper's range either, because the weight P is the construction's `envelope`, which is extended by zero off the clock cells (`envelope_nonneg`, `envelope_copy`), so for v outside the slot the Lean's majorant is 0 and the bound asserts that the field and its derivatives vanish there — true of these fields, and strictly more than (6.29) says.
